# High-Performance Leadership and Management

This contributed chapter presents a model for organizational change management based on research-identified capabilities that drive software delivery performance.

## The Need for Sustained Capability Development
High performance cannot be purchased or copied. It requires developing capabilities through sustained effort, investment, focus, and time, tailored to the organization's context and goals.

## The Value of Software Delivery Performance
Since nearly all organizations rely on software, delivery performance is critical. High performance in software delivery—quality, speed, stability—drives commercial outcomes (profitability, productivity, market share) and non-commercial outcomes (efficiency, customer satisfaction, mission achievement). This makes it a key value driver and differentiator across all industries.

## A Framework for Transformation
The chapter provides a framework for technology transformation, synthesizing research on the factors creating high-performing teams. This research reveals consistent relationships between delivery performance, technical practices, automation, leadership, and a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

## The Research Foundation
The key capabilities are identified through statistical analysis, confirming their significant contribution to software delivery performance. The discussion of these practices, supported by examples, is intended to guide improvement efforts. The research design and analysis methods provide the scientific basis for the results.

## The Path Forward
The model outlines how to begin a technology transformation using the identified capabilities and practices, enabling organizations to improve their technology, business processes, work culture, and improvement cycles.

# High-Performance Leadership and Management

This chapter, contributed by Steve Bell and Karen Whitley Bell, presents a model for organizational change management based on the capabilities identified in the research. It outlines what implementing these practices entails for innovative organizations.

## The Need for Sustained Capability Development
High performance cannot be purchased or copied. Organizations must develop their own capabilities through a sustained effort that includes investment, focus, and time. The path must fit the specific organizational context and goals.

## The Value of Software Delivery Performance
The research establishes that software delivery performance is a critical driver of organizational performance. This holds true because nearly all modern organizations rely on software. High performance in software delivery—defined by quality, speed, and stability—directly impacts commercial outcomes like profitability, productivity, and market share, as well as non-commercial outcomes like efficiency, customer satisfaction, and mission achievement.

## A Framework for Transformation
The chapter provides a framework to begin a technology transformation, synthesizing years of research into the factors that create high-performing teams. This research, including peer-reviewed publication and work with transforming organizations, reveals consistent relationships between delivery performance, technical practices, automation, leadership, and a culture of continuous learning.

## The Research Foundation
The findings are grounded in a scientific approach, as detailed in Part II of the book. The identification of key capabilities is based on statistical analysis, confirming their significant and meaningful contribution to software delivery performance. The discussion of these practices, supported by examples, is intended to guide improvement efforts.
